answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities. Each identity posts 30 POA for one slot per epoch; 5 POA burns at expiry even if unused. Slots are audited against completed work, whether mapping a dune, tending an orchard, or monitoring a tundra sensor, so names alone hold no slot. Forging 1,000 identities costs 30,000 POA per epoch and burns 5,000 POA, with no bulk discount. An honest agent pays one deposit and is not diluted by fakes.
